## Key Production Projects
- **BYOUR (Intelligent Hiring Infrastructure):** Production AWS infrastructure with automated GitLab CI/CD, Terraform/Terragrunt, AWS Bedrock integration, RDS read replicas, and Route53 automated failover (https://byour.co/).
- **UA-IE Car Scout (Live SaaS):** Real-time meta-search aggregator and financial calculator bridging Ukrainian and Irish automotive markets with Puppeteer anti-bot scraping (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/ua-ie-car-scout).
- **AI Ticket Classifier:** Production Flask SaaS API utilizing Google Gemini 2.0 Flash for automated support ticket classification with Stripe billing and Prometheus metrics (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/ai-ticket-classifier).
- **AWS S3 Simulator with Observability:** S3-compatible object storage simulator built with MinIO and Flask, instrumented with Prometheus, Loki, Promtail, and Grafana monitoring (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/aws-s3-simulator).
- **DealShop (Irish Bilingual Marketplace & Escrow Platform):** Production Web & Mobile marketplace (dealshop.ie). Next.js 16 Turbopack, Flutter Android AppBundle, 1,043 automated tests, Stripe escrow payments.

## Technical Case Studies & Architecture Blueprints
- **Dual-LLM Failover Architecture (Zero-Outage AI Microservices):** Production architectural blueprint on eliminating AI Single Points of Failure (SPOF) using Redis circuit breakers, Pydantic contracts, and automated hot-standby fallback from Google Gemini 2.0 Flash to OpenAI GPT-4o-mini. Measured 99.98% availability SLA, <48ms failover RTO, and ~71% inference cost reduction (https://artemrivnyi.com/docs/dual-llm-failover-architecture.html).
